name: Newsletter
description: An email sign-up with a clear promise, one field and visible error/success states. Use it once per page.

fields.name: Text
fields.helpText: What subscribers get and how often. Include the offer if there is one.

fields.name: Field label
fields.helpText: Always visible above the input. Defaults to "Email address" when unset.

fields.name: Placeholder
fields.helpText: An example, never an instruction. Defaults to "name@example.com" when unset.

fields.name: Consent
fields.helpText: One line with a privacy link. Inline links only.

fields.name: Require a consent checkbox
fields.helpText: Adds a checkbox that must be ticked before submitting. Never pre-ticked.

fields.name: Consent checkbox label
fields.helpText: Shown only when the checkbox above is on.

fields.name: Success title
fields.helpText: Defaults to "You're on the list" when unset.

fields.name: Success text
fields.helpText: For example the confirmation step and the welcome code.

fields.name: List
fields.helpText: The marketing list or audience id in the connected email app.
